scope: Working diff and bounded offline natural-language variants for all four requested defects

initialChecks.note: Three initial abbreviated ownership queries used the fallback route and were replaced by fully routed wording. No live/model verification.

initialFindings.query: A foreign employee became a Singapore PR on 15 March 2026. The first year ends on 31 March 2027, and we pay him a bonus then. Does the bonus attract CPF?
initialFindings.observed: Source support true, CURRENT_WORKFLOW_FACT, CPF VERIFIED, no 2027 applicability limitation
initialFindings.required: Preserve the shared future payroll date regardless of clause subject

initialFindings.query: Employee E1 became a Singapore PR on 15 March 2026. Staff E2 remains a foreigner. Is CPF due on E1’s March Ordinary Wages and what is the first-year boundary?
initialFindings.observed: Answer incorrectly describes the established PR employee as a foreigner without a boundary
initialFindings.required: Accept possessives of safely established alphanumeric identifiers

queries: Does CPF apply to the annual bonus that the employment income includes?
Does CPF apply to the annual bonus which is included in employment income?
Please report the annual bonus as employment income, and explain whether CPF applies to this bonus.
Report the annual bonus as employment income. Does CPF apply to this bonus?
initialFindings.observed: Factual relative clauses add IRAS INSUFFICIENT; report-led imperatives lose IRAS
initialFindings.required: Bind reporting intent and object to the requested predicate; preserve direct imperatives

passingInitialControls: Lowercase a/b with a’s and article ownership withholding
ALPHA/BETA employee safeguards and repeated ordinary prose
No-comma and reversed future bonus-date clauses

secondReview.priorFindings: All three exact initial findings corrected

findings.query: A foreign employee became a Singapore PR on 15 March 2026. His bonus becomes payable, when the first contribution year ends on 31 March 2027. Does the bonus attract CPF?
findings.result: Boundary-only predicate true; CURRENT_WORKFLOW_FACT. The payable then, when variant also marks CPF VERIFIED.

findings.query: Should the annual bonus, which was earned in 2025, be reported as employment income, and does CPF apply to this bonus?
findings.result: Only CPF planned; reporting predicate lost after relative clause

finalReview.scope: Final source/test diff and bounded offline application variants covering all four requested defects and all confirmed review findings
controls: Lowercase and E1 possessives; article-safe ownership
Attached future dates including reversed comma clauses and cross-sentence then
Single-employee prose and genuine distinct identifiers
Descriptive income suppression; explicit, imperative, passive-relative, IR8S and two-sentence reporting
